lines.zh: 我贴着湖底的黑石慢慢游。
lines.en: I glide low over the dark stones of the lake bed.

lines.zh: 水草擦过我的斑纹，有点痒。
lines.en: Weeds brush my mottled sides and it tickles.

lines.zh: 三五条同伴跟在我尾后。
lines.en: Three or four kin trail close behind my tail.

lines.zh: 清水里，我的影子先游过去。
lines.en: In clear water my shadow swims ahead of me.

lines.zh: 我顺着河道往上游顶水。
lines.en: I push upstream against the river's current.

lines.zh: 每摆一次尾，鳞片闪一下暗光。
lines.en: Each tailbeat flashes a dim light off my scales.

lines.zh: 湖面结了冰，我在下面照游。
lines.en: Ice seals the lake, and I keep swimming beneath it.

lines.zh: 我绕开渔网的影子。
lines.en: I steer around the shadow of the net.

lines.zh: 深水凉，我的斑纹更黑了。
lines.en: The deep runs cold, and my markings turn blacker.

lines.zh: 一群小鱼让开，我懒得追。
lines.en: A shoal of minnows parts and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我把背鳍收起来，穿过石缝。
lines.en: I fold my dorsal fin to slip through the rocks.

lines.zh: 湖湾水面平静，我转了个圈。
lines.en: The bay is glassy, so I turn a slow circle.

lines.zh: 我沿河岸的阴影游了一程。
lines.en: I follow the bank's shadow for a long stretch.

lines.zh: 上钩那天，我也是这样游的。
lines.en: The day I was hooked, I was swimming just like this.

lines.zh: 我贴着岸边的泥底游，斑纹隐了。
lines.en: I skim the muddy bottom by the bank, stripes fading.

lines.zh: 同伴一转身，整群就跟着转。
lines.en: One turns, and the whole shoal turns with it.

lines.zh: 石头底下有阴影，我钻了进去。
lines.en: Shade under the rock. I slip into it.

lines.zh: 我摆尾的力气不大，水纹很细。
lines.en: My tail pushes lightly and the ripples stay thin.

lines.zh: 我悬在草茎之间，鳍都不动。
lines.en: I hover between the stalks with every fin still.

lines.zh: 阳光透到湖底，我眯着眼。
lines.en: Sunlight reaches the lake bed and I squint.

lines.zh: 我张嘴喝一口水，又闭上。
lines.en: I take a mouthful of water and close it.

lines.zh: 斑纹藏在石影里，很难找。
lines.en: My markings vanish into the stone's shade.

lines.zh: 同伴在旁边打盹。
lines.en: One of my school dozes right beside me.

lines.zh: 我不动，等小虫自己靠近。
lines.en: I wait still until the insects come to me.

lines.zh: 湖底冒起一串小气泡。
lines.en: A string of small bubbles rises from the mud.

lines.zh: 鳃盖一开一合，很慢。
lines.en: My gill covers part and close, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我把肚子贴在温热的浅沙上。
lines.en: I press my belly to the warm shallow sand.

lines.zh: 水面有鸟影，我沉低一点。
lines.en: A bird's shadow crosses, so I sink lower.

lines.zh: 我数着水草摆动的次数。
lines.en: I count how many times the weeds sway.

lines.zh: 河湾安静得能听见水滴。
lines.en: The bend is so quiet I hear each droplet.

lines.zh: 我偏过身子，任水穿过鳃缝。
lines.en: I lean aside and let water thread my gills.

lines.zh: 那条大鲈鱼又在老地方发呆。
lines.en: The old crappie broods in its usual hollow.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，斑纹一缩。
lines.en: I look up at you and my markings contract.

lines.zh: 水面暗了一块，是你来了。
lines.en: A patch of water darkens; it is you.

lines.zh: 我停在你靴子旁的浅水里。
lines.en: I stop in the shallows beside your boot.

lines.zh: 你手里有竿，我认得那味道。
lines.en: You carry a rod; I know that smell.

lines.zh: 我歪头，一只眼始终盯着你。
lines.en: I tilt, one eye fixed on you the whole time.

lines.zh: 清水让我把你的脸看得很清。
lines.en: Clear water lets me read your face plainly.

lines.zh: 我不逃，只是把鳍立起来。
lines.en: I do not flee, I just raise my fins.

lines.zh: 你在岸上站了很久，我也看了很久。
lines.en: You stand there long; I watch just as long.

lines.zh: 我从石缝探出半截身子。
lines.en: I push half my length out of the crevice.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾着别处的湖泥。
lines.en: Your boots carry mud from another lake.

lines.zh: 我猛地一抽，斑纹全炸开。
lines.en: I jerk hard and every marking flares.

lines.zh: 疼得我撞进了水草丛。
lines.en: The pain drives me into the weeds.

lines.zh: 我的鳍抖得停不下来。
lines.en: My fins will not stop trembling.

lines.zh: 水里有我自己的血味。
lines.en: The water carries the taste of my own blood.

lines.zh: 我翻身沉到石头缝里。
lines.en: I roll over and sink into the rock gap.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，什么也没喊出。
lines.en: I gape, and not a sound comes out.

lines.zh: 那一击让我游得歪了。
lines.en: That blow leaves my swimming crooked.

lines.zh: 我贴着湖底喘。
lines.en: I press against the lake bed and gasp.

lines.zh: 我的鳞掉了一片，飘上去了。
lines.en: A scale tears loose and drifts upward.

lines.zh: 我缩起背鳍，尽量变小。
lines.en: I fold my dorsal fin and make myself small.

lines.zh: 蚯蚓的味道顺水流过来了。
lines.en: The smell of a worm drifts down the current.

lines.zh: 我绕着饵转，先不咬。
lines.en: I circle the bait and hold my bite.

lines.zh: 那团红虫在水里扭，很诱人。
lines.en: The red worms squirm, and I want them.

lines.zh: 我张嘴试了试，又合上。
lines.en: I open my mouth, test it, and shut it.

lines.zh: 饵沉到底，我的斑纹跟着动。
lines.en: The bait sinks and my markings follow it.

lines.zh: 我知道钩子藏在里面。
lines.en: I know there is a hook hidden in there.

lines.zh: 那味道让我忘了水有多凉。
lines.en: That smell makes me forget how cold it is.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一摆，冲到饵旁边。
lines.en: One tailbeat and I am right beside the bait.

lines.zh: 同伴都盯着我，等我先动。
lines.en: My school watches, waiting for me to move first.

lines.zh: 就一口，我告诉自己只一口。
lines.en: Just one bite, I tell myself, only one.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，撞到我的侧身。
lines.en: You step into the water and bump my flank.

lines.zh: 我弹开半尺，斑纹炸开。
lines.en: I dart away and my markings flare wide.

lines.zh: 桶壁撞得我鳞片发麻。
lines.en: The bucket wall numbs my scales.

lines.zh: 你的手碰到我，我猛甩尾。
lines.en: Your hand touches me, and my tail whips.

lines.zh: 船底擦过我的背，好响。
lines.en: A boat's hull scrapes my back, loud and rough.

lines.zh: 我撞上石头，眼睛发花。
lines.en: I knock into a stone and my eyes swim.

lines.zh: 同伴挤过来，我被顶偏了。
lines.en: A kin crowds in and shoves me aside.

lines.zh: 网边碰到我，我立刻缩身。
lines.en: The net grazes me and I pull in tight.

lines.zh: 你一靠近，水就浑了。
lines.en: You come close and the water clouds.

lines.zh: 我被撞得转了个身才稳住。
lines.en: The bump spins me around before I steady.

lines.zh: 我把斑纹张到最亮。
lines.en: I spread my markings as bright as they go.

lines.zh: 她绕着水草丛转圈。
lines.en: She circles the clump of weeds.

lines.zh: 我们并肩顶水，谁也不让。
lines.en: We push upstream side by side, neither yielding.

lines.zh: 我拍尾打出一串水泡。
lines.en: I slap my tail and release a line of bubbles.

lines.zh: 春天的浅湾最适合产卵。
lines.en: The spring shallows are the best place to spawn.

lines.zh: 我守在她旁边，赶走小鱼。
lines.en: I stay beside her and chase off smaller fish.

lines.zh: 三月的湖水还是凉的。
lines.en: The March lake water is still cold.

lines.zh: 我们蹭了蹭侧身，算是答应。
lines.en: We brush flanks, and that is my answer.

lines.zh: 卵落在石缝里，很安静。
lines.en: Eggs settle into the crevice, quietly.

lines.zh: 她游远了，我还留在原地。
lines.en: She swims off and I linger where we were.

lines.zh: 我叼起一块落水的面包。
lines.en: I pick up a scrap of bread fallen in the water.

lines.zh: 那粒玉米沉在我嘴边。
lines.en: A kernel of corn sinks right by my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把石子当成食物咬了咬。
lines.en: I bite a pebble, mistaking it for food.

lines.zh: 水面漂来的果子，我收下了。
lines.en: A fruit drifts by, and I accept it.

lines.zh: 我含着小虫游回水草里。
lines.en: I carry the insect back into the weeds.

lines.zh: 同伴想抢，我侧身躲开。
lines.en: A kin tries to steal it; I slip aside.

lines.zh: 那东西太硬，我吐了出来。
lines.en: It is too hard, so I spit it out.

lines.zh: 我把它压在石头下藏着。
lines.en: I pin it under a stone and hide it.

lines.zh: 钓线掉下的饵我也捡。
lines.en: I even pick up bait dropped from a line.

lines.zh: 我叼着东西游得慢了。
lines.en: Carrying something makes my swimming slower.

lines.zh: 水花一响，我立刻转向。
lines.en: A splash, and I turn toward it at once.

lines.zh: 一条水蛇进了我的湖湾。
lines.en: A water snake has entered my bay.

lines.zh: 我盯上那只踩水的甲虫。
lines.en: I fix on that beetle paddling on the surface.

lines.zh: 有东西在草里动，我锁定了。
lines.en: Something moves in the weeds and I lock on.

lines.zh: 那条大鱼靠得太近。
lines.en: That bigger fish is coming too close.

lines.zh: 我压低头，鳍绷紧了。
lines.en: I drop my head and stiffen every fin.

lines.zh: 岸边的手伸进来，我警惕了。
lines.en: A hand reaches in from the bank; I go wary.

lines.zh: 钓线落点被我记下了。
lines.en: I have marked where the line landed.

lines.zh: 同伴散开，我留在最后。
lines.en: My school scatters; I stay at the rear.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛只锁一个目标。
lines.en: My eyes hold exactly one target now.

lines.zh: 我围着它转，找侧面的空当。
lines.en: I circle it, hunting an opening at its flank.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的斑纹就跟着紧。
lines.en: Each twitch of its body tightens my markings.

lines.zh: 我贴着湖底逼近，不溅水。
lines.en: I creep along the bed without a splash.

lines.zh: 水流朝我这边，正合适。
lines.en: The current runs my way, which suits me.

lines.zh: 它的鳍在抖，我看得清楚。
lines.en: Its fins are trembling and I see it clearly.

lines.zh: 我算好了，再近一尺就冲。
lines.en: One more foot and I will make my dash.

lines.zh: 那群小鱼挡住了它的退路。
lines.en: The shoal of minnows blocks its retreat.

lines.zh: 我张合着嘴，慢慢数它的呼吸。
lines.en: I work my jaw and count its breathing.

lines.zh: 影子压在它身上，它还没发觉。
lines.en: My shadow lies on it, and it has not noticed.

lines.zh: 我保持这个距离，不动。
lines.en: I hold this distance and do not move.

lines.zh: 我一口咬在它侧腹。
lines.en: I sink my teeth into its flank.

lines.zh: 甩尾拍水，把它掀翻。
lines.en: A tail slap turns it over in the water.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，鳞片蹭出响声。
lines.en: I ram it, scales grinding with a rasp.

lines.zh: 它退，我追，水草全乱了。
lines.en: It retreats, I follow, and the weeds tangle.

lines.zh: 我叼着它的鳍，死不松口。
lines.en: I hold its fin and will not be shaken off.

lines.zh: 那一口下去，水里有铁味。
lines.en: That bite leaves iron in the water.

lines.zh: 它甩开我，我立刻再冲。
lines.en: It throws me off, and I charge again.

lines.zh: 我用身体把它压向石头。
lines.en: I use my body to press it against stone.

lines.zh: 打完了，我嘴角还在抽。
lines.en: The fight ends, but my jaw still twitches.

lines.zh: 我虽然小，咬起来不含糊。
lines.en: I am small, but my bite is not gentle.

lines.zh: 我从河湾的浅水里醒来。
lines.en: I wake in the shallows of the river bend.

lines.zh: 一群五条，我们从草里散开。
lines.en: Five of us scatter out of the weeds together.

lines.zh: 新水面很亮，我先绕一圈。
lines.en: The new water is bright, so I circle once.

lines.zh: 我的斑纹在陌生水里发暗。
lines.en: My markings darken in unfamiliar water.

lines.zh: 河水推着我往下游走。
lines.en: The river pushes me gently downstream.

lines.zh: 第一次看见湖底，我愣住了。
lines.en: Seeing the lake bed for the first time, I freeze.

lines.zh: 同伴用头顶了顶我的侧身。
lines.en: A kin nudges my flank with its head.

lines.zh: 我试着摆尾，游得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: I try a tailbeat and swim a crooked line.

lines.zh: 这片湖比我预想的深。
lines.en: This lake runs deeper than I expected.

lines.zh: 水草间有空位，我游了进去。
lines.en: There is a gap in the weeds, and I take it.

lines.zh: 四周的水发烫，我往深处躲。
lines.en: The water turns hot and I hide deeper.

lines.zh: 我从水面上摔下来，头都晕了。
lines.en: I fall from the surface and my head spins.

lines.zh: 我竟然也会呛水。
lines.en: Even I can choke on water, it seems.

lines.zh: 爆炸震得湖水都在晃。
lines.en: The blast sets the whole lake rocking.

lines.zh: 有支箭斜着划开了我的背鳍。
lines.en: An arrow slices my dorsal fin at an angle.

lines.zh: 咒文钻进鳞片，凉得反常。
lines.en: Magic seeps under my scales, unnaturally cold.

lines.zh: 湖里没虫，我饿得发轻。
lines.en: No insects in the lake, and I grow light.

lines.zh: 雷落在湖面，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the surface and numbs me.

lines.zh: 脚下没有水了，只有黑。
lines.en: No water beneath me now, only black.
